chunks: ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Sa’d ibn Sa’d, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Ziyārah of Fāṭimah, daughter of Mūsā (peace be upon her). He said: ‘Whoever goes to her Ziyārah, for him is Paradise.’

key_terms.فَاطِمَة بِنْت مُوسَى: Fatimah, daughter of Musa (AS), known as Fatimah al-Ma'sumah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Fatimah bint Musa (AS)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) declares that visiting Fāṭimah bint Mūsā (peace be upon her) guarantees Paradise, a profound promise that underscores the elevated spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt within Shia tradition. This narration, recorded by Ibn Qulawayh in *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, emphasizes the intercessory and merit-based nature of Ziyārah, linking physical visitation to eternal reward and reinforcing the continuity of divine favor through the progeny of the Imams.
